title: Construct a cybed:OrganizingUnit node — build_organizing_unit_node
text: Every framework's top-level enumerated unit instance cybed:OrganizingUnit (subClassOf skos:Concept), cross-framework abstract lets one SPARQL query reach every framework's parent units uniformly. Workforce frameworks (NICE, DCWF, ENISA ECSF) unit genuinely work role work profile additionally assert cybed:Role (subClassOf cybed:OrganizingUnit); pass is_role = TRUE . Non-workforce frameworks (SFIA enumerates skills; Cyber.org K-12, CSTA, CSEC2017, DigComp 3.0 enumerate organizing units) assert cybed:OrganizingUnit . unit also carries per-framework subtype (e.g., nice:WorkRole, sfia:Skill, csta:StandardGroup, cyberorg:StandardGroup). Cross-framework queries target cybed:OrganizingUnit; framework-specific queries target per-framework subtype; workforce-queries target cybed:Role. backward-compatible workforce-construction, see build_role_node().

Rows derived pattern carry node_type == "Subpoint" promoted cybed:Subpoint nodes. full algorithm known limitations documented docs/framework-data-sources.md.
